svg.text: Actors, containers and external systems. One codebase runs three ways: local (one process), Vercel (CDN + one function), AWS (ECS web + worker fleet).
pastes a URL, gets a video
Web tier — ui/server.ts · stateless, N instances
Chromium (Playwright) — one warm instance shared per worker
claim SKIP LOCKED · heartbeat · setProgress · saveRecording · finish (fenced)
one process: web + in-process Worker (poked on enqueue)
CDN serves the prerendered pages; one Function runs the server
no browser → jobs refused unless LAB_EXTERNAL_WORKER=1
and a `lab worker` elsewhere shares the database
Route 53 → ALB → ECS web (≥ 2) + ECS workers (1..N, Fargate)
Supabase Postgres for state + queue · S3 for media
scale workers on the oldest queued job's age (docs/SCALING.md)
